framework_basis: Unified Intelligence / HIL Framework v1.6 (item-validity protocol)
changes_from_v1_0: audit_items.py added; run against v1.0 it reports 5 errors, recorded in docs/AUDIT_v1_0.md
4 bound instances rewritten: 16 instances had only 12 distinct payloads, so 3 C0/C1 pairs and 1 T0/T1 pair could not discriminate between their levels
DI-T1-DATA_ANA-A restated as a goal rather than a procedure
concordance_audit.py added: flags items where executors of different tiers return the same answer and the key disagrees with all of them
run_log.schema.json given actual properties (v1.0 declared required with no properties, so only key presence was validated) plus item_score, failure_mode, response_digest, executor_tier, paired_with
score_hil.py reports S_graded, headroom, failure-mode counts and concordance readiness; a v1.0-shaped log scores identically
2 generator-bound T4 delegation tasks registered by reference rather than copied in
known_limitations: audit_items.py is a filter with unknown recall; unflagged items are unaudited, not validated
concordance_audit.py needs run data from at least two capability tiers and has an unquantified false-positive rate at two
650 of 668 rows remain specification-only and have no answer key to be right or wrong
I-I1-RESTART_CONT-A simulates its restart inside one payload; a real I1 instance needs a harness that terminates a process
docs/dashboard_preview.png plots attempted episodes only; one weaker-executor shift_cover seed was delivered as an unmodified stub and is excluded as a delivery failure, not a capability result
